text: DSH Local Share（DSH Web 插件）：把 DSH 会话中的全部或选定对话轮次整理为可预览、复制或下载的分享文档。它在 Web 会话标题栏提供 Share 操作，并通过 Host 服务读取会话后在本地生成 Markdown、独立 HTML 或长 PNG。用户可选择轮次、控制是否包含工具调用，并使用默认开启的文本脱敏。适合希望整理和分享 DSH 对话内容、同时决定导出范围与格式的 Web 用户；无需配置 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Local Share exports DSH Web session turns as Markdown, self-contained HTML, or a long PNG. Use Share in the session header to preview and choose turns, then copy or download. Redaction starts enabled; no API key or external service is needed.

DSH Local Share 的功能「按轮次导出会话」：打开 Web 会话标题栏的 Share，可预览会话并勾选一个或多个对话轮次，再生成 Markdown 或自包含 HTML，复制文本或下载文件。
DSH Local Share 的功能「生成长图并控制工具内容」：在分享对话框中切换 Markdown、HTML 或 PNG；工具调用默认不包含，可手动启用。PNG 根据当前预览生成，导出内容支持复制或下载。
DSH Local Share 的功能「脱敏预览」：打开 Share 时默认启用脱敏，预览区展示会话内容及导出统计，用户可检查后复制或下载。
dsh-local-share 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 12；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-local-share README · DSH Local Share：Turn selected conversation turns or a complete DSH Session into a reviewable
document without uploading the conversation. DSH Local Share adds a **Share**
action to the Web Session header, builds a local preview, and lets you copy or
download the result.

dsh-local-share README · DSH Local Share：- Select one or more conversation turns, or share the complete Session
- Markdown, one script-free self-contained HTML file, or one long PNG
- Safe GFM rendering for assistant headings, lists, tables, and code
- Best-effort redaction enabled on every dialog opening
- Stable, flicker-free preview before copy or download
- Tool names, bounded arguments, and outcomes are opt-in
- Tool result bodies and model reasoning are never exported
- No cloud service, account, public-link backend, or outbound request
- Zero model-visible text and zero model-token overhead

dsh-local-share README · Quick start：DSH is currently a developer preview. Install the exact npm release into the
Web profile, then start DSH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-share@0.5.0
dsh --profile web
```

GitHub remains an alternative source:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ChuanTianML/dsh-local-share#v0.5.0
```

Open a non-empty Session and select **Share** in its header. The safe defaults
are Markdown, tool calls excluded, and redaction enabled.

To remove the plugin:

dsh-local-share README · Quick start：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-local-share
```

dsh-local-share README · Upgrading from DSH Share 0.1.0：Version 0.2.0 and later use a distinct package and plugin id to avoid colliding with an
unrelated community plugin named `dsh-share`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-share
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-share@0.5.0
```

dsh-local-share README · See the privacy flow：The dialog starts safe. If redaction is turned off, copy and download stay
locked until the user gives a fresh acknowledgement; reopening the dialog
restores the safe defaults.

The recording uses the real Web application and an isolated DSH profile. The
example Session contains benign demonstration text only.

dsh-local-share README · Install with a Coding Agent：Use this plugin when the user wants to share selected DSH conversation turns
without uploading the complete Session or its export. Installation,
configuration, and verification use inspectable CLI commands and one YAML
profile patch. Paste this request into a Coding Agent that has terminal access
to the machine where DSH is installed:

```text
Install DSH Local Share 0.5.0 into my DeepSeek Harness Web profile.

dsh-local-share README · Install with a Coding Agent：1. Detect the active DSH_HOME and dsh version. Do not modify another profile.
2. Inspect the repository package.json lifecycle scripts before installation.

For an evaluation that must not touch an existing setup, tell the Agent to use
a fresh temporary `DSH_HOME` for steps 1–6.

dsh-local-share README · Host configuration：The defaults work for ordinary Sessions. For an explicit, auditable setup, add
the complete config object to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`
(`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` when `DSH_HOME` is unset):

```yaml
- id: dsh-local-share
  config:
    maxEvents: 20000
    maxOutputChars: 2000000

dsh-local-share README · Host configuration：Harness profile patches replace the target `config` object rather than deeply
merging individual fields, so writing all three limits is the clearest option.
Confirm the final composition without starting the Web server:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

dsh-local-share README · Host configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `maxEvents` | `20000` | Maximum raw Session events accepted |
| `maxOutputChars` | `2000000` | Maximum file or preview characters |
| `maxToolArgumentChars` | `12000` | Maximum retained arguments per enabled tool call |

Session and output overflows fail visibly. Tool arguments alone may be
truncated, with a warning in the preview. Invalid values fail when the plugin
loads.

dsh-local-share README · Privacy behavior：| Content | Default | Optional |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Human prompts | Included | — |
| Visible assistant text | Included | — |
| Tool names, bounded arguments, outcomes | Excluded | Enable “Include tool calls” |
| Tool result bodies | Excluded | Never included |
| Reasoning / thinking | Excluded | Never included |
| System prompts and request configuration | Excluded | Never included |
| Plugin-injected user-role context | Excluded | Never included |
| Attachment bytes and Session metadata | Excluded | Never included |

dsh-local-share README · Privacy behavior：Redaction covers common credentials, authorization headers, secret-bearing
environment assignments, email addresses, and absolute local paths. It is
heuristic, not a guarantee. Always review the preview. If redaction is disabled,
copy and download remain locked until a fresh risk acknowledgement is checked.

dsh-local-share README · Privacy behavior：The preview runs in a sandboxed `srcdoc` iframe. Generated HTML has no scripts or
external resources and carries a restrictive Content Security Policy. Long PNGs
are generated from that same safe preview in the browser and are never uploaded.
Visible assistant text is rendered as safe GFM; human prompts remain literal so
the shared document preserves what the user actually entered.

dsh-local-share README · Why this plugin instead of the Session log ZIP?：The official Session log export is the right lossless ZIP for diagnosis and
migration. DSH Local Share produces a smaller, human-readable document for code
review, issue reports, handoffs, and knowledge sharing. It intentionally omits
data that a replay or forensic workflow would need.

dsh-local-share README · Development：The verified Harness revision is
`b830ec950faba0a46dda564be3e2d854afed94f1`. Keep the checkout isolated under
`.sandbox/harness`:

```sh
corepack enable
corepack install --global pnpm@11.7.0
pnpm install
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git .sandbox/harness

dsh-local-share README · Development：`DSH_HARNESS_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness` selects another read-only
development checkout. `pnpm run check` runs strict type checks, ESLint, unit and
composition tests, Host/browser builds, coverage, and a package dry run. Built
`lib/` artifacts are committed because GitHub profile installs do not run a
build step.

Run `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` and `pnpm run test:browser` for
real-browser download and privacy checks. See [release validation](docs/validation-0.5.0.md).
dsh-local-share README · Development：The complete product and security design is in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md).

dsh-local-share README · Compatibility：Version 0.5.0 requires Harness >=0.2.1-rc.5 and <0.3.0. It is verified
against the published 0.2.1-rc.5 runtime and its matching source revision.
Upgrade Harness before upgrading this plugin; the former client-runtime module
is no longer used. Older Harness builds are not supported by this release.
DSH does not yet promise stable external plugin compatibility; future
Harness changes may require a new DSH Local Share release.

dsh-local-share README · Security：See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Never include a real credential or private
Session in a public issue.
